equal.sentenceEn: In their 2020 study, the researchers interviewed nearly 80 employees at two London-based firms—an equal number of men and women between the ages of 30 and 50, all with at least one dependent child—who worked in middle or senior management roles.
equal.translationZh: 在2020年的研究中，研究人员采访了伦敦两家公司的近80名员工——男女各占一半，年龄在30至50岁之间，均至少有一个需要抚养的子女——这些人担任中层或高层管理职位。

equal.sentenceEn: A retired vice president from a major chemical company stated, "Young women engineers are on an equal footing until they have children, then they struggle to balance work and family—and compete with men who don't have the same household responsibilities."
equal.translationZh: 一家大型化工公司的退休副总裁表示：“年轻女性工程师在生育前与男性处于平等地位，但有了孩子后，她们就要艰难地平衡工作与家庭，还要和那些没有同等家庭责任的男性竞争。”
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

equal.sentenceEn: At the end of the program, cooking confidence and skills were equal across both counterparts.
equal.translationZh: 课程结束时，男女参与者的烹饪信心和技能水平相当。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

equal.sentenceEn: According to Horn, drivers making constant adjustments for equal spacing between cars in a flow of traffic can help reduce phantom traffic jams.
equal.translationZh: 霍恩认为，驾驶员在车流中不断调整以保持车辆间等距，可以帮助减少幽灵交通拥堵。

equal.sentenceEn: They may not be equal to people's contributions.
equal.translationZh: 它们可能与人们的贡献不相称。

entirely.sentenceEn: Understood in that way, saving for retirement is the equivalent of giving money away to someone else entirely .
entirely.translationZh: 从这个角度理解，为退休存钱就相当于把钱完完全全送给了另一个人。

entirely.sentenceEn: With extreme sports, you'll be working entirely different muscles, and that means you get an all-over workout.
entirely.translationZh: 参与极限运动时，你会用到完全不同的肌肉群，这意味着你能进行全身锻炼。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

entirely.sentenceEn: Hope is not entirely out of reach.
entirely.translationZh: 希望并非完全遥不可及。

entirely.sentenceEn: You could choose an entirely new last name for the two of you to share.

entirely.sentenceEn: It is impossible for Americans to lift themselves out of poverty entirely on their own.

entirely.translationZh: 人们出于完全不同的原因阅读它。

enormous.sentenceEn: While Formula One commands enormous audiences throughout much of the world, many American sports fans know it as that other motorsport, the one that is not Nascar(纳斯卡车赛).
enormous.translationZh: 虽然一级方程式赛车在全球大部分地区拥有庞大的观众群体，但许多美国体育迷只将其视为纳斯卡车赛之外的另一种赛车运动。

enormous.sentenceEn: The challenges are enormous , even if everyone is pulling in the same direction.
enormous.translationZh: 即便所有人都齐心协力，挑战依然巨大。

enormous.sentenceEn: The purpose of such action is to fund an enormous multibillion-dollar, 10-year program of housing and social services for the homeless.

enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

enormous.sentenceEn: According to one famous entrepreneur, innovation means refusal to do an enormous number of things.
enormous.translationZh: 一位著名企业家认为，创新意味着拒绝做大量的事情。

enormous.sentenceEn: He won enormous fame and love from British people.
enormous.translationZh: 它赢得了英国人民极大的喜爱和声望。

efficiency.sentenceEn: The supermarket imitated the Fordist factory, with its emphasis on efficiency and standardization, and reimagined it as a place to buy food.

efficiency.sentenceEn: All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency , collaboration and cohesion.
efficiency.translationZh: 所有这些举措都是为了提高工作效率、促进团队协作并增强凝聚力。
efficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

efficiency.sentenceEn: When their hobby was both serious and similar to their job, then spending more time on it actually decreased their work efficiency .
efficiency.translationZh: 当他们的爱好既严肃认真又与工作相似时，在爱好上花费更多时间实际上会降低他们的工作效率。
efficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

efficiency.sentenceEn: But some experts worried that such public speculation might lead people to believe that disagreement about the details meant a lack of adequate scientific consensus over the safety and efficiency of modern-day medicine.
efficiency.translationZh: 但一些专家担心，这种公开推测可能会让人们认为，对细节的分歧意味着现代医学的安全性和有效性缺乏足够的科学共识。
efficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

efficiency.sentenceEn: But if there's one thing that triggers widespread employee frustration, it's an IT transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of promised efficiencies has been reversed.
efficiency.translationZh: 但是，如果说有什么事情最容易引发员工普遍不满的话，那就是失败的信息技术转型项目——过高的期望化为泡影，一大堆承诺的效率提升反而变成了效率下降。

expose.sentenceEn: All living organisms on Earth are exposed to a 24-hour day-night cycle.

expose.sentenceEn: Instead, he credits old-school games like Palace of Magic with exposing him to computers.
expose.translationZh: 相反，他将自己接触电脑归功于《魔法宫殿》等老派游戏。

expose.sentenceEn: If we eat something too hot or too cold, or if the tooth is worn down enough where the tissue underneath is exposed , all of those things cause pain, and then the pain causes the person not to use that tooth to try to protect it a little bit more.
expose.translationZh: 如果我们吃了太烫或太冰的东西，或者牙齿磨损严重导致下方组织暴露，所有这些情况都会引起疼痛，而这种疼痛会促使人们不再使用那颗牙齿，以便更好地保护它。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

expose.sentenceEn: Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule, based on factors such as the religion in their society.
expose.translationZh: 基于社会宗教等因素，不同的人往往接触到不同形式的黄金法则。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

expose.sentenceEn: While cultural holidays are celebrated, the injustices experienced by Asian Americans are not exposed in elementary school classrooms.
expose.translationZh: 虽然文化节日得到庆祝，但亚裔美国人所经历的不公并未在小学课堂中被揭露。

expose.sentenceEn: An innovative way to beat obesity is to expose food companies' manipulative and deceptive practices.
expose.translationZh: 战胜肥胖的一种创新方法是揭露食品公司那些操纵性且具有误导性的手段。

extend.sentenceEn: He said most Indiana schools already use digital devices during lessons, so it was an "easy decision" to extend this to days when schools are closed.
extend.translationZh: 他表示，印第安纳州的大多数学校在课堂上已经使用数字设备，因此将其扩展到学校关闭期间是一个“容易的决定”。

extend.sentenceEn: Next is the bubble called "personal space", extending from 1.5 feet to 4 feet away.
extend.translationZh: 接下来是称为“个人空间”的范围，距离我们1.5英尺到4英尺不等。
extend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

extend.sentenceEn: The smallest zone, called "intimate space", extends outward from our bodies 18 inches in every direction.
extend.translationZh: 最小的区域称为“亲密空间”，从我们身体向各个方向延伸18英寸。
extend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

extend.sentenceEn: Extending from 4 to 12 feet away from us is "social space".
extend.translationZh: 距离我们4到12英尺的范围是“社交空间”。

extend.sentenceEn: An extended lifespan in the future will allow people to have more careers than now.
extend.translationZh: 未来寿命的延长将使人们拥有比现在更多的职业。

extend.sentenceEn: Running is the best exercise for extending one's life.
extend.translationZh: 跑步是延长寿命的最佳运动。

elderly.sentenceEn: She stands accused of leaving a minor in danger in the care of the elderly .
elderly.translationZh: 她被指控将未成年人置于危险境地，交由老年人照顾。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

elderly.sentenceEn: Named locally as Karla, she lives alone with her elderly grandmother and her blind grandfather.
elderly.translationZh: 这名女孩在当地被称为卡拉，她与年迈的祖母和失明的祖父相依为命。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

elderly.sentenceEn: You sit next to the elderly woman, who unfortunately turns out to be quite skilled at picking pockets.
elderly.translationZh: 你选择坐在那位年长女士旁边，不幸的是，她原来是个扒窃高手。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

elderly.sentenceEn: One is next to a small, elderly woman; the other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
elderly.translationZh: 一个座位旁边是一位身材瘦小的老妇人；另一个座位旁边是一位肌肉发达、面相凶狠的男子。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

elderly.sentenceEn: Young people do less cooking at home than the elderly these days.
elderly.translationZh: 如今，年轻人在家做饭的频率低于老年人。

emphasis.sentenceEn: With so much emphasis on employee wellness these days, company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution.
emphasis.translationZh: 如今，员工健康备受重视，企业志愿者项目或许是2025年的完美解决方案。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

emphasis.sentenceEn: The supermarket imitated the Fordist factory, with its emphasis on efficiency and standardization, and reimagined it as a place to buy food.
emphasis.translationZh: 超市效仿了福特式工厂，强调效率和标准化，并将这种模式重新构想为购买食品的场所。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

emphasis.sentenceEn: However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking.
emphasis.translationZh: 然而，这些课程未能提供真正的教育，它们强调的是便利性而非批判性思维。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

emphasis.sentenceEn: Other trends included an emphasis on the importance of parenting.
emphasis.translationZh: 其他趋势包括对为人父母重要性的强调。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

emphasis.sentenceEn: An Asian-American studies professor placed greater emphasis on teacher training than on teachers' background.
emphasis.translationZh: 一位亚裔美国人研究教授更强调教师培训而非教师背景。

emphasis.sentenceEn: It has placed much more emphasis on cure than on prevention.
emphasis.translationZh: 它一直以来都重治轻防。

entire.sentenceEn: But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved.
entire.translationZh: 但要让志愿服务真正惠及员工和工作场所，就需要整个组织的参与。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

entire.sentenceEn: I was surprised that the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey and avoiding sleeping on the plane.
entire.translationZh: 令我惊讶的是，专家竟然建议在整个航程中禁食，并避免在飞机上睡觉。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

entire.sentenceEn: "With caution, many relational methods to improve teams and organisations can be borrowed from other fields. The question is how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective, which is more than just the sum of individual relationships," said Dr. Matous.

entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

entire.sentenceEn: The costs of any damage to the dorm, including elevators, bathrooms, and common areas, are billed to every person on a dorm floor, or even the entire building if they do not know who caused the damage.
entire.translationZh: 宿舍内任何设施的损坏费用，包括电梯、浴室和公共区域，都会分摊到同一楼层的每位学生头上；如果无法确定损坏责任人，甚至会由整栋楼的学生共同承担。

entire.sentenceEn: The experience of using IT penetrates almost the entire work field.

entire.translationZh: 这些方法必须结合使用，以增强整个集体的凝聚力。

ease.sentenceEn: The rate of growth has begun to ease (sales were up 7% in the year, compared with 8% the previous year).
ease.translationZh: 增长率已开始放缓（本年度销售额增长7%，而上一年度为8%）。

ease.sentenceEn: "General farm management can go a long way toward easing changes."
ease.translationZh: 常规农场管理对缓解这些变化大有帮助。

ease.sentenceEn: Indeed, as they get older and are given more freedom, they often ease up on social networking.
ease.translationZh: 的确，随着年龄增长并获得更多自由，他们往往会减少社交媒体的使用。

ease.sentenceEn: What is the key factor that eases student tutors' learning?
ease.translationZh: 促进学生辅导员学习的关键因素是什么？
他现在可以轻松理解了。

ebike.sentenceEn: Two years ago, CEO Chris Cocalis of Pivot Cycles, which sells high-end mountain bikes, found that U.S. bike shops weren't interested in stocking ebikes .
ebike.translationZh: 两年前，销售高端山地自行车的Pivot Cycles公司首席执行官克里斯·科卡利斯发现，美国自行车商店对库存电动自行车并不感兴趣。
ebike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ebike.sentenceEn: Although ebikes first appeared in the 90s, cheaper options and longer-lasting batteries are breathing new life into the concept.
ebike.translationZh: 虽然电动自行车早在90年代就已出现，但如今更实惠的价格和续航更持久的电池正为这一概念注入新的活力。
ebike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

ebike.sentenceEn: Now that sales are taking off, the vast majority of bike dealers are asking Cocalis when he'll make an ebike available.
ebike.translationZh: 如今电动自行车销量飙升，绝大多数自行车经销商都在询问科卡利斯何时会推出电动自行车产品。
ebike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

ebike.sentenceEn: "When people first jump on an ebike , their face lights up. It's exciting and joyful in a way that you don't get from a regular bike."
ebike.translationZh: 当人们第一次骑上电动自行车时，他们的脸上就会露出笑容。那种兴奋和愉悦的感觉是普通自行车无法带来的。
ebike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

ebike.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about ebikes ?
ebike.translationZh: 从文章中我们能了解到关于电动自行车的哪些信息？

ebike.translationZh: 它将从电动自行车共享中获益。

emerge.sentenceEn: Among them are architect Asif Khan, a Design Museum trustee who has worked as designer-in-residence at the museum, helping emerging architects.
emerge.translationZh: 其中包括建筑师阿西夫·汗，他是设计博物馆的受托人，曾担任该馆驻馆设计师，为新兴建筑师提供帮助。

emerge.sentenceEn: In particular, studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia showed that each bat used a form of bilateral control to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm(一大群), Horn said.
emerge.translationZh: 霍恩表示，特别是对东南亚数百万只黄昏时分从洞穴中飞出的蝙蝠的研究显示，每只蝙蝠都采用了一种双侧控制方式，以降低在密集群体中与其他蝙蝠相撞的可能性。

emerge.sentenceEn: This suggests that communicating more abstractly does not reflect a fixed tendency of men or women but rather emerges within specific contexts.
emerge.translationZh: 这表明，更抽象的沟通方式并不反映男性或女性的固定倾向，而是在特定情境中形成的。

emerge.sentenceEn: Indeed, the latest research that has emerged on language and aging shows that language mastery is a journey that we begin as infants and continue on for the rest of our lives.

emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

emerge.sentenceEn: And the quality and quantity of work I can do emerges directly from my ability to concentrate.
emerge.translationZh: 而我工作的质量和数量，直接取决于我的专注力。

emerge.sentenceEn: What happens when a new technology emerges ?

error.sentenceEn: The 20% error rate observed in the study likely underestimates the extent to which people would struggle to tell an artificial face from the real thing outside of the lab.
error.translationZh: 研究中观察到的20%错误率可能低估了人们在实验室之外难以区分人造面孔与真实面孔的程度。

error.sentenceEn: The brightest people and strongest leaders sometimes make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense.
error.translationZh: 最聪明的人和最杰出的领导者有时会犯其他人不会犯的错误，尤其是在需要常识的情况下。

error.sentenceEn: These reduce the likelihood of errors and increase the chances of success.
error.translationZh: 这些（数据和分析）能够降低犯错的可能性，提高成功的几率。

error.sentenceEn: When Stanford University scholar Andrea Lunsford gathered data on the rates of errors in "freshman composition" papers going back to 1917, she found that they were virtually identical to today.

error.sentenceEn: Students now write longer and more complex essays than their counterparts in previous decades while the error rates remain unchanged.
error.translationZh: 与前几十年的学生相比，现在的学生撰写的论文篇幅更长、内容更复杂，而错误率保持不变。

error.sentenceEn: Automatic driving systems are by no means immune to errors .
error.translationZh: 自动驾驶系统绝非不会出错。

evil.sentenceEn: Evil is typically referred to when there is deviance from social norms: formal deviance is the violation of laws, like theft, murder, and attacks, while informal deviance involves violations of social norms, like lying.
evil.translationZh: 当行为偏离社会规范时，我们通常会称之为邪恶：形式违规是指违反法律，如盗窃、谋杀和袭击；而非形式违规则涉及违反社会规范，如说谎。

evil.sentenceEn: We must try to understand what we have labeled evil .
evil.translationZh: 我们必须努力去理解那些被我们贴上“邪恶”标签的事物。

evil.sentenceEn: Calling someone evil is often similar to saying they cannot change, and perhaps aren't even a human at all.
evil.translationZh: 称某人为邪恶，往往无异于断言他们无法改变，甚至可能根本不配为人。

evil.sentenceEn: Like evil , we often view heroism as only a possibility for outliers—for people who are abnormal.
evil.translationZh: 与邪恶一样，我们常常认为英雄主义只可能存在于那些异于常人的人——也就是那些不正常的人——身上。

evil.sentenceEn: The reasons for people's evil behaviors can be explained in more ways than one.

embrace.translationZh: 当人们在危机中走投无路时，往往更倾向于拥抱变革。

embrace.sentenceEn: Embrace life for ourselves and for others.
embrace.translationZh: 为自己，也为他人，拥抱生活。

emotionally.sentenceEn: I'm an emotional learner, which means I need to connect to information emotionally to understand it.

emotionally.sentenceEn: "When people book their holidays they get so emotionally involved, and when they find that villa at a good price with availability in peak season, they are an easy target," says Cooper.

emotionally.sentenceEn: The findings suggest that some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good, says Bechtoldt.
emotionally.translationZh: 贝克托尔德说，研究结果表明，有些人的情商可能高到对自己反而不利。

emotionally.sentenceEn: A study published in 2002 in Personality and Individual Differences suggested that emotionally perceptive people might be particularly influenced by feelings of depression and hopelessness.

environmentally.sentenceEn: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast-fashion manufacturers pump out low-quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times and then discarded.

environmentally.sentenceEn: Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.

environmentally.sentenceEn: The video from National Geographic was created to spread awareness of how environmentally harmful cotton is.

equality.sentenceEn: He said equal parental leave is an essential component to creating gender equality in the workplace.
equality.translationZh: 他说，平等的育儿假是在工作场所实现性别平等的重要组成部分。

equality.sentenceEn: Thus, the researchers argued that gender equality is not just a women's rights issue.
equality.translationZh: 因此，研究人员认为，性别平等不仅仅是一个妇女权利问题。
equality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

equality.sentenceEn: UK universities are world leaders when it comes to advancing and promoting gender equality .

equality.sentenceEn: According to one father, equal parental leave is indispensable to achieving gender equality in the workplace.

explanation.sentenceEn: But if we take a good look, the word "evil" is insufficient—there are no simple explanations for why humans do bad things: instead there are many, and they are all marvelously different.

explanation.sentenceEn: What did the researchers want to determine by testing a variety of possible explanations ?

exploration.sentenceEn: Exploration by the Curiosity Rover proves that billions of years ago it was once a planet similar to Earth.

educated.sentenceEn: Pay has risen sharply for the highly educated , and those people continue to reap rich rewards into old age because these days the educated elderly are more productive than the preceding generation.

earthquake.translationZh: 随后又发生了两次地震。

engagement.sentenceEn: Catherine Ritman Smith, head of learning at the Design Museum, is expecting around 10,000 participants aged 13 to 16 to take part this year and says that the project—funded by Deutsche Bank as part of its youth engagement programme Born To Be—is the biggest event in the museum's calendar.
engagement.translationZh: 设计博物馆学习部主管凯瑟琳·里特曼·史密斯预计，今年将有约1万名13至16岁的参与者参加。她表示，该项目由德意志银行资助，是其青年参与计划"天生不凡"(Born To Be)的一部分，也是博物馆日程表上规模最大的活动。

engagement.sentenceEn: For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement .
engagement.translationZh: 对我们而言，灵活排座意味着撤掉大部分传统的课桌椅，并引入多种不同的座位选择，以提升学生的参与度。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

engagement.sentenceEn: From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions.
engagement.translationZh: 根据我们目前的经验，灵活的座位安排增强了学生对空间的主人翁意识和学习参与度，同时也降低了学生消极参与和违纪行为的发生率。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

engagement.sentenceEn: "The engagement and powerful skills that people get playing a game — why can't work be like that?" he asks.
engagement.translationZh: 他问道：“人们在玩游戏时获得的那种投入感和强大的技能感——为什么工作就不能也像那样呢？”

engagement.sentenceEn: Red Rum traveled all over the country for various engagements .
engagement.translationZh: 雷德罗姆（Red Rum）走遍全国参加各种活动。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

engagement.sentenceEn: Educational videos may deliver academic content, but they are unable to make eye contact or assess a student's level of engagement .
engagement.translationZh: 教育视频或许能够传递学术内容，却无法与学生进行眼神交流，也无法评估学生的投入程度。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

enroll.sentenceEn: What about enrolling him in Lakeview School?
enroll.translationZh: 让他进湖景学校就读怎么样？
enroll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

enroll.sentenceEn: "Growing up, I would always watch my family and see the lion dance, and I slowly grew interested in it." By the age of 14, he was fully enrolled in the athletic club's lion dance group.
enroll.translationZh: “从小到大，我总是看着家人表演舞狮，慢慢地就产生了兴趣。”14岁时，他正式加入了该运动俱乐部的舞狮队。

enroll.sentenceEn: But after being enrolled in an online course last fall semester, I came to realize online classes were merely a means to fulfil course requirements.
enroll.translationZh: 但去年秋季学期参加了一门在线课程后，我才意识到在线课程仅仅是满足课程要求的一种手段。
enroll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

enroll.sentenceEn: So she enrolled me into a ballet course when I was six.
enroll.translationZh: 于是，在我六岁那年，她给我报了芭蕾舞班。
enroll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

enroll.sentenceEn: She said, "I started Engineering For Kids (EFK) after noticing a real lack of math, science and engineering programs to enroll my own kids in."
enroll.translationZh: 她说：“我发现真正缺乏适合自己孩子报名参加的数学、科学和工程类课程，于是便创办了‘儿童工程学’（EFK）。”
enroll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

enroll.sentenceEn: What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes?
enroll.translationZh: 作者对注册在线课程的学生有何看法？

episode.sentenceEn: But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing.
episode.translationZh: 但其中也不乏幽默元素和足够多有趣的情节，使作品颇具吸引力。
episode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

episode.sentenceEn: According to England's Hospital Episode Statistics, children aged one to four were the most likely to need help from doctors for a foreign object in their nose.
episode.translationZh: 根据英格兰医院事件统计数据，1至4岁儿童最有可能因鼻腔异物需要医生帮助。
episode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

episode.sentenceEn: Each episode will focus on a different area of science, and tell us what we know, how we know it, and what we still don't know.
episode.translationZh: 每集将聚焦科学的不同领域，告诉我们已知什么、如何得知以及我们仍未了解的内容。
episode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

episode.sentenceEn: It is sunburn that is most worrying—recent research shows five episodes of sunburn in the teenage years increase the risk of all skin cancers.
episode.translationZh: 最令人担忧的是晒伤——近期研究表明，青少年时期经历五次晒伤会增加患所有皮肤癌的风险。
episode.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

episode.sentenceEn: What do we learn from England's Hospital Episode Statistics?
episode.translationZh: 我们从英格兰医院事件统计数据中了解到什么？

episode.sentenceEn: Find out the show's most interesting episodes .
episode.translationZh: 找出该节目最有趣的剧集

excessive.sentenceEn: There's nothing wrong with trying to look our best, but excessive focus on physical appearance misses the soulful aspects of what it means to be beautiful.
excessive.translationZh: 努力展现自己最好的一面无可厚非，但过度关注外表会忽略美丽的灵魂层面。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

excessive.sentenceEn: One major side effect of excessive ambition is the tendency to focus too determinedly on one particular vision or end goal.
excessive.translationZh: 过度野心的一个主要副作用是倾向于过分执着地专注于某个特定愿景或最终目标。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

excessive.sentenceEn: But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath.
excessive.translationZh: 但过高的温度会使你脱水，这已被证实会产生一个相当不雅的副作用——口臭。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

excessive.sentenceEn: Data connecting excessive digital media time to mental health issues suggests a limit of two hours a day of free time spent with screens, a restriction that will also allow time for other activities—like going to the movies with friends or reading longer, more complicated texts.
excessive.translationZh: 将过多数字媒体使用时间与心理健康问题联系起来的数据表明，每天的屏幕休闲时间应限制在两小时内，这一限制也能为其他活动留出时间——比如和朋友去看电影，或阅读更长、更复杂的文本。

excessive.sentenceEn: Boredom has been linked to behavior issues including inattentive driving, mindless snacking, excessive drinking, and addictive gambling.
excessive.translationZh: 无聊与多种行为问题相关，包括驾驶时分心、无意识吃零食、过度饮酒和成瘾性赌博。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

excessive.sentenceEn: He has been burdened with excessive work.
excessive.translationZh: 他一直被过多的工作所困扰。

exhaust.sentenceEn: To maintain a serious hobby, people need to invest significant psychological resources, say the authors—so if the activity has the same kinds of demands as their work, they may be left exhausted and unable to perform well at their job.
exhaust.translationZh: 作者表示，要维持一项投入认真的爱好，人们需要付出大量心理资源——因此，如果这项活动与工作有类似的要求，人们可能会感到疲惫不堪，无法在工作中表现良好。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

exhaust.sentenceEn: Get enough of those particles in one place, as from the exhaust of a ship, and they can lead to the creation of new clouds easily visible from space.
exhaust.translationZh: 当这些颗粒物在一个地方聚集到足够数量时——例如来自一艘船的废气——它们就会形成从太空可以清晰看到的新云层。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

exhaust.sentenceEn: When ships power their way through the ocean, they pump exhaust into the atmosphere, just as cars do.
exhaust.translationZh: 当船只在海洋中航行时，它们会像汽车一样向大气中排放废气。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

exhaust.sentenceEn: Once all the obvious answers were exhausted , participants gave more and more inventive answers to combat boredom.
exhaust.translationZh: 当所有显而易见的答案都被用尽后，参与者为了克服无聊，给出了越来越多富有创意的答案。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

exhaust.sentenceEn: Just lengthening that second stage of full-time work may secure the financial assets needed for a 100-year life, but such persistent work will inevitably exhaust precious intangible assets such as productive skills, vitality, happiness, and friendship.
exhaust.translationZh: 仅仅延长全职工作的第二阶段或许能积累百年人生所需的财务资产，但这种持续不断的工作将不可避免地耗尽宝贵的无形资产，如生产技能、活力、幸福感和友谊。

exhaust.sentenceEn: Each ship was coal-powered by several boilers constantly kept running by exhausted crews below deck.
exhaust.translationZh: 每艘船均以燃煤为动力，数台锅炉由甲板下筋疲力尽的船员们持续操作运转。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句
